propositions: DC comment and description outbound paths lack convergence test suites, while Cloud has two incident-hardened suites that verify oversized text truncates identically across two passes

DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and fit_outbound, but this binding's provenance and correctness are undocumented, creating doubt about whether the limit is the actual Jira constraint

Existing tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations or _diff_comments without explicit backend injection silently fall back to Cloud's backend via select_backend(load_config()), causing DC convergence tests to measure Cloud's behavior while reporting DC coverage

DC's comment and description truncation use identical 32767 limits and suffix markers as Cloud, making value-based assertions insufficient to prove the correct backend executed; identity or recording checks are required for comment tests
